messages.author: Cario
messages.text:
I humbly beg that the War Room cards display the Action Points available. So that you dont have to click on every card to see whether you can do anything yet and then forget and click on the same one again because they're IN NO PARTICULAR ORDER which brings me to point number 2...

War cards should be displayed in order of when they were declared. Oldest on top or newest on top, either would be fine, just so long as there's a reliable way of scrolling to the one you want. Currently it seems like they order according to score of the enemy nation, so they jump around!

messages.author: Cario
messages.text: Also adding to what others have said, a war shouldn't be finished in 2 hours

messages.author: Cario
messages.text: 24-48 is much more reasonable pacing to allow time for both parties to act

messages.author: Justinian
messages.text: I probably spent a good while trying to figure out where the attack option was, normally it's displayed right on the page not on a separate one
